whereAll.context: History: after the entry count when searching, e.g. '12 entries across all months'. Lowercase.

whereDay.context: History: after the entry count when a calendar day is picked; {day} is e.g. 'Mon, 22 Sep'. Lowercase.

whereMonth.context: History: after the entry count; {month} is the month name alone. Lowercase.

searchPlaceholder.context: History: placeholder of the search field.

searchLabel.context: History: accessible label of the search field.

clearSearch.context: History: accessible label of the × in the search field.

calendarView.context: History: button that shows the calendar heatmap.

entries.context: History: number of entries shown; followed by 'in September' etc.

newest.context: History search: only the newest {count} results are shown. Lowercase.

clearFilters.context: History: button in the empty state.

showEntries.context: History filters sheet: button that closes it.

show.context: History filters: label above All / Spent / Income.

who.context: History filters: label above the people.

both.context: History filters: both people (budget of two).

order.context: History filters: label above the sort options.

andMore.context: History (laptop) > Where it went: more categories not shown.

removeFilter.context: History: accessible label of the × on an applied filter chip.
